en_us.message.eclipse.limbo.no_break: Nothing here breaks. Limbo is not yours to dig.
en_us.message.eclipse.limbo.no_place: Nothing takes hold here. Limbo refuses what you build.
en_us.message.eclipse.limbo.no_pvp: Not here. Limbo does not take the living from each other.
en_us.dev.eclipse.doc.limbo.pvp: Allows or forbids player-vs-player damage in Limbo (persisted, OFF by default). An active boss fight lifts the block on its own.
en_us.dev.eclipse.doc.limbo.status: Shows the effective Limbo house rules: build lock and PvP state, including a boss fight currently lifting the PvP block.
en_us.dev.eclipse.limbo.status.build: Break/place: LOCKED for everyone (/devmode is the only bypass)
